'''Pel Aydaer''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Appearance ==
Master Aydaer is bald.

== History ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] is held captive by [[Geofram Bornhald]], Perrin thinks that the furniture in Lord Bornhald's tent is something that Pel would appriciate.{{ref/book|1|30}}

== Activities ==
When Perrin returns to the Two Rivers after the [[Trolloc]] attacks, Pel is one of the familiar faces.{{ref/book|4|42}} Since the influx of refugees, Pel has had to hire five apprentices to help work on furniture.{{ref/book|6|p}}

He is currently traveling with Perrin's army in [[Ghealdan]]. He goes with the scouts into [[Cairhien]] to look for [[Rand al'Thor]].
